summary: Master the implementation of Accounting Information Systems with our expert-led course.Gain practical skills to enhance your organization's financial management
lede: Accounting information systems implementation helps finance professionals turn accounting needs into ERP processes and controls. For financial controllers, accounting systems analysts, ERP project professionals, and internal auditors, the work includes mapping transaction cycles and defining requirements. Training covers control matrices and access risks, migration validation and testing, and go-live planning with dashboards for exceptions and implementation progress.
audienceIntro: This foundation-to-intermediate course suits professionals who connect accounting policy, financial operations, internal control, and enterprise systems during implementation or improvement initiatives.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of accounting transactions, financial statements, and basic internal controls is recommended. No programming is required. Familiarity with ERP terminology is helpful but not essential. Participants should bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based analysis and dashboard exercises. Advanced ERP configuration, software development, and production deployment are introduced at an operational application level rather than taught as technical engineering.
